note: §38 (Lamedh 'Aleph verbs). Transcribed from scan (grammar pp. 126-127, key pp. 82-86); list forms checked against the key; B7-8 unpointed in print (pointed in key).

items.prompt: נִבְרָא
items.answer: We will create (1 pl. impf. Qal); or he was created (3 s. m. pf. Niph.); or (the) one (or thing) that has been created (ptc. Niph.)

parse.alt: he was created (3 s. m. pf. Niph.); or (the) one (or thing) that has been created (ptc. Niph.)

items.prompt: תַּחֲטִיא
items.answer: Thou wilt (or she will) cause to sin (Hiph.)

parse.gloss: Thou wilt (or she will) cause to sin

items.prompt: וַחֲטָאתֶם
items.answer: And ye will sin (pf. Qal)

items.prompt: תֶּחֶטְאוּ
items.answer: Ye will sin (impf. Qal)

items.prompt: מִלֵּאתִיךָ
items.answer: I have filled (Pi.) thee (m.)

items.prompt: קְרֶאןָ
items.answer: Call ye (2 plur. fem. imper. with loss of the ה, for קְרֶאנָה: Ruth 1:20)

items.prompt: וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ
items.answer: And they found him

items.prompt: יַמְצִאֶנּוּ
items.answer: He will cause him to find (Hiph. with nûn energ., Job 34:11)

parse.gloss: He will cause him to find

items.prompt: יָרֵאנוּ
items.answer: We fear (§ 22. 6) or we feared (1 pl. pf. Qal)

items.prompt: אִמָּלְאָה
items.answer: I will or would (or let me) be filled (cohortative Niph., § 23. 1. 2)

parse.gloss: I will or would (or let me) be filled

items.prompt: יִשָּׂאֵנִי
items.answer: He will lift me up (or take me away; impf. Qal of נשׂא)

items.prompt: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־בָּנָיו הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים
items.answer: And Jacob said to his sons, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the days to come.

items.prompt: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם רָע
items.answer: And the king of Israel said, I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but evil.

items.prompt: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׂאוּנִי וַהֲטִילֻנִי אֶל־הַיָּם וְיִשְׁתֹּק הַיָּם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם
items.answer: And he said to them, Take me up and cast me into the sea, that the sea may grow calm (and cease) from (raging) against you.

items.prompt: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁרְצוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם
items.answer: And the Israelites swarmed and grew strong, and the land was filled with them.

items.prompt: כֹּה אָמַר יהוה אֲנִי מַרְעִישׁ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם וּמִלֵּאתִי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה כָּבוֹד
items.answer: Thus saith Yahweh, I am about to shake all the nations, and I will fill this house with glory.

items.prompt: נִמְצֵאתִי לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא בִקְשֻׁנִי אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּנִי הִנֵּנִי אֶל־גּוֹי לֹא קֹרָא בִשְׁמִי
items.answer: I have let myself be found by those who did not seek me; I have said, Here am I, here am I, to a nation that was not called by my name.

items.prompt: אמר הכהן הגדול ספר התורה מצאתי ויתן את־הספר אל־הספר ויקראהו
items.answer: The high priest said, I have found the book of the law, and he gave the book to the secretary, and he read it.

data.pointed: אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה מָצָאתִי וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־הַסֹּפֵר וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ

items.prompt: וימצאהו איש וישאלהו לאמר מה־תבקש
items.answer: And a man found him and asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

items.prompt: Yahweh will hear when thou criest to him.
items.answer: יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקָרְאֲךָ אֵלָיו

items.prompt: I am full (perf.) of the spirit of judgment and of power, to tell to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
items.answer: מָלֵאתִי רוּחַ מִשְׁפָּט וּגְבוּרָה לְהַגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב פִּשְׁעוֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל חַטָּאתוֹ

items.prompt: And the earth was filled with violence.
items.answer: וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס

items.prompt: Hast thou found-me, mine enemy? and he said, I have found-thee.
items.answer: הַמְצָאתַנִי אֹיְבִי וַיֹּאמֶר מְצָאתִיךָ

items.prompt: Thou hast filled this house with thy glory.
items.answer: מִלֵּאתָ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ

items.prompt: Thou hatest (perf.) all workers of iniquity.
items.answer: שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן

items.prompt: And the spirit of Yahweh lifted-him up and cast him to-(the)-earth.
items.answer: וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ רוּחַ יְהוָה וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה

items.prompt: Thou shalt love thine enemy, thou shalt not hate him in thy heart.
items.answer: תֶּאֱהַב אֶת־אֹיִבְךָ לֹא תִשְׂנָאֵהוּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ

items.prompt: Unless ye had ploughed (perf.) with my heifer, ye would not have found (perf.) my riddle.
items.answer: לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם חִידָתִי
